decisions.reason: It strengthens the firm's floor-care system offer and its upgraded standalone presentation in 2024 suggests sufficient market relevance to retain it.
The maintenance oil line fits the installed base of wooden floors well, but its lower web prominence indicates some portfolio-rationalisation risk if demand is uneven across models.
Care products for oiled wood floors are a natural recurring complement to the core flooring business, and the move to a dedicated page points to continued commitment.
Moisture-protection underlay supports the firm's system-selling approach, though as a less differentiated accessory it faces a moderate risk of being streamlined.
High-density underlay foam is useful alongside floor sales, but its commodity character and overlap with other underlay options make it the most exposed to pruning.
An oak parquet line is close to the firm's core offer and strategic identity, so despite modest web emphasis it is likely to stay in the range.
